summary: Gate of supervision, i47 round 1: 2 questions on r177 (r178 raises none). Questions 1-3 of the round's gate concern requests lines and belong to the requests proposal's gate.
questions: supervision, r177 against r4. Lines: added [r177] **While** no work-item accepts a requirement that a scenario names, `work run` shall count a failure of that scenario in the whole-suite run of a work-item's branch as expected. r4 merges a work-item branch only if the whole suite passes "but for the failing scenarios r43 counts as expected"; as drafted, a failure r177 counts as expected still blocks the merge. Reading A (recommended): r177 lets the merge through: change r4 to "[r4] **When** an implementer's session ends with a result that gives no question, `work run` shall merge its work-item branch into the initiative branch only if the work-item's scenarios pass on it and the whole suite passes on it but for the failing scenarios r43 and r177 count as expected." Reading B: r4 stays.

supervision, Implementation note for r177. Line: added [r177] (as above). The existing note "r122: the checks are the whole-suite runs of r24 and r43" names the runs; r177 says only "the whole-suite run of a work-item's branch". Reading A (recommended): r177 covers both runs: add the Implementation line "r177: the whole-suite runs are those of r24 and r43; `--whole-suite` marks each such scenario as xfail." Reading B: only r43's run before a merge: "r177: the whole-suite run is r43's, before a merge."
